name: LangScribe
tagline: Language learning platform with graded English/Japanese ladder lessons, video transcription, and bilingual subtitles.
description: LangScribe is a language learning platform, not just a subtitle tool. Discover graded English (A1–C1, including VOA Learning English-style tracks) and Japanese (N5–N1) ladder lessons already have a refined transcript and multilingual pre-translation, so you can open a lesson and start studying. The same workspace also does video transcription and speech to text in about 99 languages, and translation into about 109 languages with free or AI translation. Watch with bilingual or AI subtitles, move line by line, loop a sentence with A–B repeat, click a word to look it up, and save vocabulary cards that keep the original sentence and a short audio clip. You can transcribe lecture videos, import an SRT, subscribe to a podcast RSS feed, and export or print batch subtitles. Playback, bilingual subtitles, loops, and look-up are free to start; Pro is from $5 a month for AI credits.
